text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim and repeated position","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a definite stance early and keeps that stance easy to identify throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"“First of all… Second… They also…”","quality":"organizational structure","description":"It uses a more explicit paragraph-and-point structure that helps the argument unfold in an orderly way."},{"evidence":"expensive technology / driver still needed / court liability","quality":"reasoned development","description":"It develops several distinct reasons against driverless cars instead of relying on one broad complaint."},{"evidence":"Google Car project quote and liability question from the passage","quality":"text-based support","description":"It incorporates relevant evidence from the article to support its claims, which strengthens the argument’s credibility."},{"evidence":"“this may be very convenient, it is not necessarily a good idea”","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"It acknowledges a possible benefit before turning to the drawbacks, showing more argumentative balance."},{"evidence":"“therefore virtually pointless” and “This is obviously problematic”","quality":"conclusionary emphasis","description":"It ends with a clearer wrap-up that restates the position and reinforces why the argument matters."}]}
